description.en: Two-level theme manager for DeepSeek Harness Web: pick a culture or scene first, then a style, with 58 built-in themes (Chinese/Japanese culture, festivals, developer palettes, national flags, high-contrast pairs) applied live via the theme service.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 两级主题管理器：先选文化/场景，再选具体风格；内置 58 套主题（中国/日本文化、节庆、开发者配色、国旗、高对比等），经 theme 服务实时切换生效。
